candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - vertical accuracy of the LiDAR data
verified_facts: EA specifications require absolute height error below +/-15cm RMSE against Ground Truth Survey data.
EA expects relative height error or random error to be no more than +/-5cm.
semantic_limits: Absolute RMSE and relative/random error are different quantities; neither alone proves parcel-level difference accuracy or cancels independent errors.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Removal of Esri Image Services / Open Standards survey-service update
verified_facts: EA states legacy Esri Image services were replaced by open-standard WCS and WMS services.
EA states WMS presents a summarised version of elevation data while WCS provides elevation values where hillshade is also published.
EA republished LiDAR composite DSM and DTM feeds with updated endpoints and First/Last Return naming.
semantic_limits: Rendered or summarised WMS imagery must not be sampled as authoritative numeric elevation when a WCS/raw raster elevation service is required.
